question: What comprehensive benefit is attributed to the declared ṣoḍaśī mantra?
premises: This is declared to be the ṣoḍaśī mantra.
It bestows the fruit of all desires.
inference: Therefore the ṣoḍaśī mantra fulfills all desires.
plain_english: This is she, the ṣoḍaśī, declared to bestow the fruit of all desires.
